definitions.gloss: to load; to load up; to pack into
definitions.explanation: To load cargo, luggage, or goods into a vehicle, container, or ship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I loaded the luggage into the car.

examples.japanese: ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To load a large number of cardboard boxes onto a truck.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}む⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われた→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: On moving day, I was busy loading furniture onto the truck from early morning.

notes:
{積|つ}み{込|こ}む means to load or pack cargo into a vehicle or container.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: [object]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[destination]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}む

ASPECT (ている):
{積|つ}み{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ can mean either "is in the process of loading" or "has been loaded" (resulting state), depending on context.

FORMS:
A compound verb from ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to pile up, to load) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the nuance of packing things into a confined space.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}む: to load luggage
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}む: to load into a car
- ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}む: to load onto a truck

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {積|つ}み{下|お}ろす / {荷下|におろ}し: unloading (the opposite action)
- ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧: simply to stack or load (without the "into" nuance)
